# number of days from when we received a microbiome sample at an irae occurence
```{r}

sublist <- 
  dates %>% 
  mutate(days.from.irae = Microbiome.days - irAE) %>% 
  drop_na(days.from.irae)

```

```{r}



ggplot(sublist, aes(x=days.from.irae)) + geom_histogram()



```

```{r}
#irae_day <- sublist %>% mutate(irae_samps = case_when(difference <=14 &

#irae_day <- sublist %>% mutate(irae_samps = case_when(difference == -4 ~ "timepoint1", difference == -5 ~ "timepoint2", difference == -6 | difference == 7 ~ "timepoint3", difference == 10 | difference == -8 | difference == -9 | difference == 9 ~ "timepoint4", difference == -11 | difference == 11 ~ "timepoint5", TRUE ~ "no timepoint"))
                    
#iraes_days_times <- irae_day %>% mutate(time_windows = case_when(difference == -4 ~ "+/- 3 Day", difference == -5 ~ "+/- 5 Day", difference == -6 | difference == 7 ~ "+/- 7 Day", difference == 10 | difference == -8 | difference == -9 | difference == 9 ~ "+/- 10 Day", difference == -11 | difference == 11 ~ "+/- 14 Day", TRUE ~ "Out")) 
  
#define window size that will be tested
window <-seq(1,max(abs(sublist$days.from.irae )))
#pre-allocate memory to store for loop output
out <- data.frame(windowsize = window, qty = NA)


for (i in window) { 
  window.test <- abs(sublist$days.from.irae) < i
  
  out$qty[i] <- sum(window.test) 
}
head(out)
```


```{r}

out %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x=windowsize, y = qty)) +
  geom_line()

ggsave(file = "../figures/irae_windowsize.png", dev = "png", width = 10, height = 7)
```

```{r}
out %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x=windowsize, y = qty)) +
  geom_line() + 
  xlim(0,25) +
  ylim(0,40)

ggsave(file = "../figures/irae_windowsize_closeup.png", dev = "png", width = 10, height = 7)

```
```{r}
out %>% 
  filter(windowsize == 12)
```

```{r}
out.sign <- data.frame(windowsize = window,
                       qty = NA,

  window.test <- abs(sublist$days.from.irae) < i

```
